chunks: He gave you the good news only to reassure your hearts, for victory comes from God alone, and certainly God is all-mighty and all-wise.

key_terms.تَطْمَئِنَّ: To be reassured or find tranquility

ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of divine victory in Islam according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Battle of Badr, highlighting that divine victory serves not merely as military success but as a spiritual reassurance (bushra) to stabilize the believers' hearts against fear. It underscores the theological principle that while human effort is necessary, ultimate victory (nasr) is exclusively from Allah, affirming His attributes of Might and Wisdom as the source of all decisive outcomes.
